*Source: [Legends of the Spheres](https://www.drivethrurpg.com/product/447907/Legends-of-the-Spheres?affiliate_id=549120)*

Bellwethers see their hypnotic powers as but one tool in an arsenal of social influence, relying more upon conventional means of communication to achieve their goals.

## Trade Tradition

If this is this character’s first level in any class, the bellwether may select a trade tradition of their choice, and have an adroit trade rank.

This replaces the eliciter’s normal class skills.

## Blended Training

Whenever a bellwether would gain a magic talent from his class levels, he may instead choose to gain a skill talent.

This alters magic talents.

## Wordwise

At 1st level, the bellwether gains the Communication sphere and Mind sphere as bonus talents. His bonus from the persuasive class feature applies to the DC of his Communication sphere effects in addition to his Mind sphere effects, Bluff checks, Diplomacy checks, and Intimidate checks.

This replaces enchanter and alters persuasive.

## Utility Expertise

In place of the emotions gained at 2nd, 8th, 14th, and 20th level, the bellwether may choose to gain a [utility] talent at 2nd level and every even level thereafter. He may not take this option if possessing an archetype that would alter or replace these emotions.

## Intimate Link (Su)

At 15th level, whenever the bellwether charms or dominates a target (such as through the Enthrall charm from the Mind sphere, the love emotion power, or the domination eliciter class ability), the bellwether learns one of the target’s major motivations. For the purpose of your Communication sphere abilities, the bellwether may treat any creature affected by this ability as knowing one of the bellwether’s major motivations. This replaces link.
